content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) strongly supports the development and implementation of policies and payment models that aim to address the social and economic barriers preventing equitable access to healthcare. These models should be designed to support comprehensive, system-wide strategies that promote fairness in diabetes care. This can be achieved by aligning healthcare costs with the financial capacities of patients, ensuring affordability. Additionally, these models should work to minimize the administrative burdens that patients face when trying to access essential diabetes medications and devices, thereby improving accessibility and reducing disparities in care.
